description:
Team ASTRORA-1 is a group of 6 students from DSU, India, passionate about space exploration and making science fun to learn. 

For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we built Outpost Zero, an interactive web game where young learners run a Moon or Mars outpost for 30 days. Players balance power, life support, food production and radiation shielding, and face real-world events like dust storms and solar flares.
summary:
Farm Shift is a website that turns open NASA satellite data into simple farming decisions for Ramanagara, Karnataka. Farmers pick their taluk, see how rainfall, temperature, soil moisture and crop greenness have changed, get a soil health score, and receive crop rotation suggestions with clear reasons.

If the form limits the summary to one line, use this: A website that turns NASA satellite data into soil health insights and crop rotation advice for farmers in Ramanagara, Karnataka.
details: Farm Shift is a web app that helps farmers in Ramanagara district, Karnataka, understand how their land is changing and decide what to plant next. Using open NASA Earth data (NASA POWER for rainfall, temperature and soil wetness; SMAP for soil moisture; MODIS for vegetation greenness), it shows ten-year trends for each taluk, calculates a simple soil health score from 0 to 100, and recommends crops using transparent rotation rules, such as following cereals with legumes and avoiding repeat crop families. Farmers see not just numbers but clear reasons for every suggestion. Farm Shift turns complex satellite data into practical, season-ready decisions.
